feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Tau-targeting pharmacological strategies in neurodegenerative disease.
drug.zh: 靶向病理tau而非全面降低tau，是tau蛋白病治疗策略优化的关键方向。

drug.title: Comparison of double-blind and open-label decline rates in lecanemab and donanemab trials in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 双盲与开放标签阶段斜率差异提示，仑卡奈单抗和多奈单抗长期获益或被高估。

drug.title: Volume change with gantenerumab: Impact of amyloid-related imaging abnormalities and amyloid removal.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样抗体引起的脑容积变化主要源于淀粉样清除，而非ARIA相关水肿。

drug.title: Real-world implementation of lecanemab in Korean patients at a tertiary memory clinic: Safety, ARIA risk, and early treatment patterns.
drug.zh: 韩国真实世界数据显示仑卡奈单抗输注反应常见但ARIA风险可控，早期认知获益需进一步验证。

drug.title: Plasma P-tau217 for detecting amyloid clearance after donanemab in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 血浆p-tau217难以可靠监测donanemab治疗后的淀粉样蛋白清除。

drug.title: A randomized phase 1b/2 trial of ABBV-916 in adults with early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: ABBV-916显著降低早期AD患者脑内淀粉样蛋白，但高剂量安全性受限。

drug.title: Lecanemab use in Chinese patients with Alzheimer's disease: a 12-month multicenter real-world study.
drug.zh: 中国患者真实世界数据：仑卡奈单抗12个月未改善CDR-SB，ARIA发生率7.87%。

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非遗忘型不典型阿尔茨海默病多数符合抗淀粉样蛋白治疗资格，但需个体化评估。

mech.title: Therapeutic Effects of miR-29b-Enriched Nanovesicles on Mitochondrial Injury and Neuroinflammatory Processes in Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: miR-29b纳米囊泡通过修复线粒体损伤和抑制神经炎症改善阿尔茨海默病病理。

mech.title: LC-MS-based metabolomics reveals the In Vivo effects of cognitive formula 1 in rats with Aβ-induced Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: CF1通过调节甘油磷脂和氨基酸代谢改善Aβ诱导的AD大鼠认知损伤。

mech.title: Mutation-resolved single-cell transcriptomics reveals enhanced β-amyloid clearance in TET2-mutant human monocytes.
mech.zh: TET2突变单核细胞经转录组解析，增强吞噬功能促进β-淀粉样蛋白清除。

mech.title: Multi-omics identification of haptoglobin as a novel target for increased Alzheimer's disease risk associated with obesity through inhibiting the phagocytosis of Aβ by disease-associated microglia.
mech.zh: 肥胖通过触珠蛋白抑制疾病相关小胶质细胞吞噬Aβ，从而增加阿尔茨海默病风险。

mech.title: Tau-Targeted PROTACs Degrade Pathology-Associated Tau and Improve Memory in Alzheimer's Disease Models.
mech.zh: 靶向Tau的PROTAC降解病理性Tau并改善AD模型小鼠记忆。

mech.title: Multilayered Silica-Core/Chitosan-Coated Nanostructures Co-Delivering Tamoxifen and Quercetin Mitigate LPS-Associated Neurodegenerative and Alzheimer's Disease-Like Alterations.
mech.zh: 多层硅基壳聚糖纳米粒共递送他莫昔芬与槲皮素，可缓解LPS诱导的AD样神经退行性改变。

mech.title: The potential connection between inflammatory bowel disease and Alzheimer's disease: mechanistic insights and therapeutic implications.
mech.zh: 炎症性肠病通过肠-类淋巴轴通路加剧阿尔茨海默病神经病理进程。

mech.title: Dissecting Alzheimer's proteomic landscape through NULISA profiling of brain cell-specific extracellular vesicles.
mech.zh: 基于NULISA的脑细胞特异性胞外囊泡蛋白组学揭示MCI阶段即出现神经保护、炎症及血管通路早期失调。

dx.title: Head-to-head comparison of plasma biomarker assays across platforms for amyloid pathology in a multicenter cohort.
dx.zh: 多中心头对头比较显示，含Aβ42的p-tau217检测平台诊断淀粉样蛋白病理效能最优。

dx.title: Emerging diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 综述AD病理机制，梳理新兴诊断标志物与治疗靶点及递送策略。

dx.title: Diagnostic value of blood p-tau subtypes in Alzheimer's disease progression and pathology: systematic review and meta-analysis.
dx.journal: European archives of psychiatry and clin
dx.zh: 血液p-tau亚型对AD进展及Aβ病理的诊断价值存在差异，需按亚型分层解读。

dx.title: Beyond amyloid: Contributions of neuroinflammation, cerebrovascular disease, and neurodegeneration to memory impairment in the oldest-old, the LifeAfter90 Study.
dx.zh: 超90岁老人中，血浆GFAP升高经脑血管病与淀粉样病变介导，加速内侧颞叶萎缩及记忆损害。

dx.title: CT1812 Attenuates Surgery-Induced Cognitive Impairment and Modulates TMEM97- and PGRMC1-Associated Hippocampal Stress Responses in Aged Mice.
dx.zh: CT1812经σ-2受体复合物调控减轻老龄小鼠术后认知损伤及海马应激。

dx.title: Interpreting p-tau217 on the ward: frailty and plasma biomarkers in acutely admitted older adults.
dx.zh: 急性住院老年患者中p-tau217水平与衰弱无关，肾功能是其主要混杂因素。

dx.title: Language-enhanced generative modeling for amyloid PET synthesis from MRI and blood biomarkers.
dx.zh: 语言增强生成模型可由MRI和血液指标合成高保真Aβ-PET，辅助AD诊断。

dx.title: Association of total and brain-derived Alzheimer's disease plasma biomarkers with brain amyloid deposition in a community-based sample.
dx.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health
dx.zh: 社区样本中脑源性p-tau217等血浆标志物可反映脑内淀粉样沉积，且受肾功能影响。

prev.title: Pharmacological interventions targeting cognition and related clinical outcomes in vascular dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
prev.zh: 血管性痴呆药物试验多发表于2012年前，证据碎片化，EGb 761证据相对最充分。

prev.title: Associations of phenotypic aging with dementia-free life expectancy among 45,608 participants with prediabetes: a prospective cohort study.
prev.zh: 表型年龄加速越高，糖尿病前期人群无痴呆预期寿命越短。

prev.title: Gaps in Population Life Course Phenotype Trajectories Underlying Major Noncommunicable Diseases: A Scoping Review.
prev.zh: 该综述揭示主要非传染性疾病生命历程表型轨迹数据存在显著空白，亟需前瞻性队列填补。

prev.title: Beyond amyloid: Contributions of neuroinflammation, cerebrovascular disease, and neurodegeneration to memory impairment in the oldest-old, the LifeAfter90 Study.
prev.zh: 超90岁老人中，血浆GFAP升高经脑血管病及Aβ病理介导内侧颞叶萎缩，导致记忆损害。

prev.title: Instrumental, Neurophysiological, cognitive and Sleep InvestiGations into the High risk of neurodegeneraTion in Late Onset Epilepsy of Unknown aetiology: the INSIGHT-LOEU study.
prev.zh: 晚发不明原因癫痫患者认知网络改变及β-淀粉样蛋白/tau病理可能早于癫痫发作，提示其痴呆高风险。

prev.title: Insulin resistance and brain health in midlife: a potential dementia prevention target.
prev.zh: 中年胰岛素抵抗独立关联额叶白质高信号及认知下降，或为痴呆预防靶点。

prev.title: Impact of national cognitive screening on dementia care and hospitalization in South Korea.
prev.zh: 韩国国家认知筛查使痴呆诊治率提升但未减少住院。

prev.title: MIND diet, cerebrovascular health, and cognition among community-dwelling older adults.
prev.zh: MIND饮食评分越高，脑小动脉硬化程度越低，且该关联独立于认知获益。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 大脑里的清洁工“小胶质细胞”一旦累坏了，就会加速老年痴呆，搞懂它才能找到延缓病情的新办法。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期睡不好可能增加老年痴呆风险，但通过调理睡眠和激素，咱们有机会提前拦住它。

intro.title: Advances in the clinical application of mesenchymal stem cells for neurological disorders.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞治疗老年痴呆等脑病的最新临床进展，对普通人来说就是了解这种疗法安不安全、有没有效。

intro.title: Gantenerumab for Early Alzheimer's Disease: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
intro.zh: 这药想清掉大脑里的“垃圾蛋白”来延缓早期痴呆，但新数据说效果一般，别指望它能治好。

intro.title: Pharmacological Effects and Molecular Mechanisms of Lignans in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这文章讲的是从植物里提取的天然成分，可能帮大脑抵抗老年痴呆，对想预防或了解这病的人有参考价值。

intro.title: Oxidative Stress in Alzheimer's Disease: Can Dietary Interventions Provide Neuroprotection?
intro.zh: 这文章讲的是：吃对东西能不能帮大脑抗老、防痴呆，简单说就是研究“怎么吃能护脑子”。

intro.title: Blood-Based Biomarkers for Alzheimer Disease in Primary Care: The Gap Between Biology and Clinical Utility.
intro.zh: 抽血查老年痴呆的苗头，现在技术有了，但家庭医生拿到结果后该咋办、准不准，还没整明白。

intro.title: Revisiting TREM2: from multi-omics signaling networks to clinical translation.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是免疫细胞上一个叫TREM2的“开关”如何影响脑瘤和老年痴呆，看懂它，能帮你理解未来相关新药为什么有效。
